fusions.name: Flattened Underfoot
fusions.desc: A stamping blow on a target at or below 25% health that deals 22 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Rear and Level
fusions.desc: You rear and bring both forehooves down, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Shod for Work
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Nail-Weighted Heels
fusions.desc: Your blunt damage cannot be resisted, and ignores 12% of the target's armour.
